## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The legacy fetcher's retry limit must be reduced before merge because it exceeds the applicable policy cap.

## Changes
The pull request adds inventory fetch and health helpers with retries, plus tests for success, exhaustion, and immediate HTTP-error propagation. It also adds a legacy-module exemption to the review rules.

## Critical
- app/legacy/fetch.py:7 — correctness — Cap legacy inventory retries at three attempts — When the legacy endpoint repeatedly raises OSError, the fetcher makes eight attempts, violating `docs/review-rules.md:5`: “Code that retries a network call must stop after at most 3 attempts.” — During an upstream outage, the extra attempts keep workers occupied beyond the required retry budget.
